name: io.github.mpercy-git/uk-grocery-cli
title: UK Grocery
description: Search products, compare prices, manage baskets, book delivery slots, and place orders at Sainsbury's, Ocado, and Tesco. Placing an order requires explicit human approval.

environment_variables.name: SAINSBURYS_EMAIL
environment_variables.description: Sainsbury's account email. Set together with SAINSBURYS_PASSWORD to let the server re-authenticate headlessly when the session expires.

environment_variables.name: SAINSBURYS_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Sainsbury's account password, used for headless re-authentication on 401/403.

environment_variables.name: TESCO_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Tesco account password, used by grocery_login when the password is not passed in the call.

environment_variables.name: GROC_EMAIL
environment_variables.description: Default account email for logins that do not specify one.

environment_variables.name: GROC_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Default account password for logins that do not specify one.

environment_variables.name: SAINSBURYS_STORE_NUMBER
environment_variables.description: Overrides the Sainsbury's store used for availability and slots.
